title: Announcements inside the merchant panel
problem: GridCommerce had no way to tell stores about news or planned downtime inside their panel.
now: Staff write, schedule and stop notices for all stores, a plan, an edition or chosen stores; shops see a banner and a What's new list.
steps: In the super admin open Communications › Merchant notices and press New notice
Pick Maintenance, give the down time and publish
Open any merchant page: the banner shows under the top bar
Dismiss it, then open What's new from the account menu
notes: Where: Super admin: Communications › Merchant notices (/admin/notices) · Merchant: banner under the top bar, account menu › What's new · Needs the server: Dismissals are kept per person in this browser; a live build keeps them on the account.

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
